metric_reading.domain: A>0, radial null curve; alpha_hist is the notation of that source, not a silent reassignment of alpha_EM.
metric_reading.derivation: 0=A*c^2-A^(-1)*(dL/dt)^2 implies abs(dL/dt)=c*A; static proper distance/time are dl=dL/sqrt(A), dtau=sqrt(A)*dt, so abs(dl/dtau)=c.
metric_reading.limit: As A approaches 0 from above, the coordinate speed approaches 0. At A=0 this static chart is singular; the formula does not derive instantaneous physical communication.
metric_reading.interpretation_limit: The source calls it informational spacetime. If v_info denotes correlation/inscription, its relation to signal propagation is an additional contract; do not identify the two without proof.
metric_reading.causal_control: A group-velocity bound alone is not equivalent to relativistic signal causality; use causal support/commutators or a justified front-velocity criterion.
